data.title: 陆八魔阿露 · 黄昏天台的社长沉思
data.description: 老旧商业楼的高层天台，落日余晖将远处的都市地平线镀上一层壮丽熔金。阿露双手扶在生锈的铁栏杆上，大衣下摆与酒红色波浪发丝在晚风中猎猎翻飞。她微微侧过头望向身旁的老师，收敛了平日的夸张架势，琥珀色的眼眸在夕阳下泛着无比真挚而沉静的光芒。
data.action: leaning on railing, windblown hair and coat, looking back calmly, gentle smile
data.lighting: brilliant golden hour rim lighting and warm dusk atmosphere
data.mood: genuine quiet sincerity and poetic evening breeze
data.promptProse: Leaning on a rusty rooftop railing overlooking a golden sunset cityscape, Rikuhachima Aru turns back calmly with windblown wine-red hair and a soft sincere gaze.
data.animaCaption: Aru turning back calmly on a windy sunset rooftop overlooking the city.
